top_signals.title: Access Considers Foreign-Asset Exit to Meet Nigeria Bank Rules
top_signals.summary: Nigeria’s top lender by assets is considering exiting at least one of its foreign markets as the business with operations in about 24 countries looks to comply with central-bank rules limiting external investments.
